title: Cross varieties of aperiodic monoids
summary: A variety of universal algebras is called Cross if it is finitely based, finitely generated, and has only finitely many subvarieties. A monoid is aperiodic if all its subgroups are trivial. In the present article, we show that a variety of aperiodic monoids is Cross if and only if it excludes, as subvarieties, a certain list of 22 almost Cross varieties. Consequently, this list of 22 varieties exhausts all almost Cross varieties of aperiodic monoids.
